jobs.description:
Modern. Smart. Straightforward. Driving Next-Gen Technical Products.

Senior Technical Product Manager (m/f/d) in Hamburg

Behind our partner company stands an international, high-growth tech organization building scalable digital platform ecosystems and consumer products reaching millions of active users worldwide every single day.

Operating in a fast-paced, high-performance market, they focus on event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and rapid data-driven feedback loops. To accelerate their technology evolution and deliver maximum product impact, we are searching on behalf of our partner for a Senior Technical Product Manager (m/f/d) with a clear ownership mindset and strong technical depth.

YOUR MISSION

- Scope, Refine & Prioritize: Translate complex business requirements into crystal-clear user stories, API expectations, and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can immediately execute on.
- Drive Technical Product Strategy & Vision: Partner closely with engineering leaders to define the product vision, roadmap, and core metrics while navigating technical constraints, architecture trade-offs, and tech debt.
- End-to-End Agile Ownership: Take full accountability for the product backlog—from refinement and sprint planning to active participation in architecture reviews and daily alignment.
- Bridge Tech & Stakeholders: Act as a high-bandwidth translator between business leaders, engineering, UI/UX, data analytics, and marketing teams to ensure end-to-end alignment across the product lifecycle.
- Experiment & Leverage AI: Utilize A/B testing, funnel analytics, and data pipelines to validate hypotheses, while actively exploring how AI tools can accelerate delivery and automate repetitive workflows.

YOUR PROFILE

- Deep Technical Fluency: Strong ability to read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, and database schemas alongside engineers as an equal sparring partner.
- Proven Product Track Record: Solid background as a Technical Product Manager delivering digital products in high-scale environments (e.g., Mobile Gaming, AdTech, E-Commerce, or MarTech).
- Mastery of Agile Backlog Management: Practical experience writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria to maximize team focus and delivery velocity.
- Data-Driven & Experimental Mindset: Skilled in using quantitative data, A/B testing frameworks, and product analytics to make objective decisions rather than relying on intuition.
- High-Scale Impact: 4+ years of experience partnering with cross-functional engineering teams on high-throughput products reaching millions of users.
- Strong Ownership & Communication: Entrepreneurial drive, clear problem-solving skills, and the ability to articulate technical details to developers while framing strategic outcomes for leadership.
- Collaborative Hybrid Setup: Thriving in a fast-paced, in-office atmosphere in Hamburg (Tuesday–Thursday).
- Language Skills: Professional fluency in English for an international setup.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

- An ambitious environment with plenty of ownership and room to shape things
- Work on scalable, data-driven products with real business impact
- Close collaboration with experienced Engineers, Product, and Data teams
- A direct impact on technical decisions and product development
- An attractive hybrid setup with a modern office in Hamburg

Ready for Your Next Challenge?

Think this could be your next move? Let’s talk. We’d love to get to know you, hear what you’re looking for, and explore whether this opportunity is the right fit for you.

Ready to build what’s next? We’d love to hear from you.

Your Tasks

As part of the Satellite Systems Engineering department, the System Performance team is responsible for controlling the system performance of our spacecraft from study phases until commissioning in-orbit. As part of our team, you will work in an inter-disciplinary environment in which you can contribute to the overall system architecture of our space missions, coordinate design and development activities related to space system performance and verify the performance requirements by analyses and tests.

Your Tasks:

In this position, you will work in collaboration with architects and subsystem engineers on tasks like:

- Modelling of the Satellite’s imaging geometry and analysis of the geometric performances
- Pointing performance engineering on subjects like microvibration, thermo-elastic deformation and others.
- Implementation of the performance calibration and development of the associated software tools.
- Performance testing at various levels (Satellite, Platform, Units) including the test evaluation.
- Algorithm development for data processing and simulation focused on satellite level aspects such as geometry.
- Implementation and Maintenance of the Satellite Characterization and Calibration Database used for the on-ground data processing
Your Qualifications

- University degree in physics, aerospace engineering, remote sensing, or similar
- Professional experience in one or more of the following categories is advantageous - Satellite design, in particular optical and/or radar missions
- Design & simulation of control systems, multibody systems, mechanisms or similar
- Geometric performances of Earth observation space missions
- End-to-End Simulation of Earth-Observation and/or Science Data
- Experience in programming (e.g. MATLAB, Python)
- Self-managed, solution-oriented and pro-active working style
- Ability to work in a team
- Working level proficiency in written and spoken English and German. Other language skills advantageous

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d) (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description:
Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and multidisciplinary cooperation. Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, over 1.800 students from 110 nations live and study on our residential campus.

Constructor University is seeking to fill a tenure-track faculty position in organic chemistry with a focus on synthetic organic chemistry, and we invite applications from interested candidates for the following position, to be filled ideally by January 2027:

Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d)
(full-time, tenure-track, initially limited to 3 years)

Your Responsibilities:

The School of Science is particularly interested in a candidate who combines experimental and computational or theoretical approaches for the development of synthetic methodology and synthesis of bioactive molecules or functional materials. The implementation of AI, machine learning, or data-driven control / optimization is highly welcome, for example, for synthesis planning, activity prediction, sensing, or structural topology. The successful candidate is expected to engage in innovative research in organic chemistry and to maintain a cutting-edge, externally funded research program that energizes the School of Science.

The successful candidate will conduct teaching in the field of organic chemistry, including fundamental and advanced lectures and laboratories at the BSc, MSc, and PhD level. The expertise in teaching organic chemistry forms an integral part of the basic education in the BSc programs “Chemistry and Biotechnology” and “Medicinal Chemistry and Chemical Biology”. Moreover, the candidate is expected to take a pivotal role in the MSc programs “Quantitative Life Science” and/or “Advanced Materials” with complementary research experience and via the development and implementation of innovative, pedagogically sound approaches to online, hybrid and in-person teaching and learning. This will also include the advising of students on their studies, and the supervision of Bachelor, Master, and PhD theses as well as research projects.

The university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. The University offers in-house adequate shared analytical research facilities, including NMR spectrometers, single crystal diffractometers, and high-resolution mass spectrometers.                                                            

Your Qualifications and Experience:

- PhD degree in Organic Chemistry
- Strong publication record in relevant international journals
- Experience in the acquisition of third-party funding is desirable
- Experience in successful teaching in international and diverse environments, integrating innovative teaching and learning approaches.
- Inclination for collaboration with CU faculty and for transfer of research knowledge into applications
- Responsible, self-motivated person able to work independently and as a part of a team
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus
- Intercultural experience and competence
- Ideally, the successful candidate should be eligible for an ERC starting grant.

What you can expect at Constructor University:

Constructor University unequivocally guarantees the academic freedom of every member of the faculty, as well as every other member of the Constructor University community.
